NativeCompletionRegistration.name: RegistrationPilot_Heldout200_q1.8_s0_NativeCompletionRegistration_v1

D_host_registration_queue.scope: Separate host-registration queue,not the vLLM scheduler or decode-ready queue. Receive-to-release excludes prior coordinator/IPC waiting. Mean occupancy uses the measured client window.

NativeCompletionRegistration.scope: First two worker output notifications. Co-delivery and asynchronous output can affect this diagnostic. The primary ITL still includes every token interval. Host step/gap is not GPU-exclusive time or physical idle. A registration completion inside a gap is overlap,not exclusive CPU causal attribution.

scope: Adaptive follow-up after observed host gaps. Original main140 and READ-repair results stay unchanged. Each plan fixes its independent seeds and controls before that plan starts performance measurements. The q1.8 plan precedes its pilot. The q2.8 extension follows the first q1.8 pilot and precedes all q2.8 measurements. Confirmation uses same400 requests and new arrivals. Registration deferral also changes admission timing and subsequent batching. No timestamp changes,no exclusive GPU claim,no active-decode safe-window predictor or dynamic 2D claim.
